ops.title: Hook exec counts before and after the Nov 12 exec-storm cuts
ops.body:
Execs per Claude Code hook event, Nov 12 exec-storm work (captain-hook #710 -> 12.121.72; binrun #18/#19 -> v0.10.1; cc-skills #4670).

Launcher, capt-hook: before 6 (sh -c, the /bin/sh->bash shim, bin/hook bash, `id -un`, binrun, capt-hookd). After 4 (sh, shim, bin/hook, capt-hookd). bin/hook reads CFBundleShortVersionString from Info.plist with builtins and execs the path capt-hookd recorded at ~/Library/Caches/captain-hook/host-v1/launch/<version> while that record is -nt bin/hook.binrun; capt-hookd writes the record whenever binrun launched it (BINRUN_PLUGIN_ROOT set).

Worker, capt-hook: before 1 `ps` per event (2 on PreToolUse/PermissionRequest, whose client parent is bin/hook's subshell parent and misses the anchor cache), plus the cc-notes pack's git probes (8 per 23 events in the capture). After: 0 ps on darwin (proc_pidinfo + KERN_PROCARGS2 in-process), git probes cached by file stamps, 0 once warm.

Other binrun plugins (cc-slack, cc-inbox, cc-review, cc-context, cc-present, cc-orchestrate, codex, slop-cop): before 3 in the launcher (`id`, binrun, artifact) after the shell; after 1 (artifact) once binrun v0.10.1 has written ~/.daemonkit/binrun/resolved/<descriptor, %->%25, /->%2F> for a static release-binary descriptor. Signed-app and python-tool descriptors get no record.

Not changed, other owners: cc-notes pack `cc-notes answer list/match` spawns, cc-slack pack `agent-inject` chain, codex-ask's `ps -o lstart= -p N` polling.
